card.name: Endings of contraindicated and route adverbs
card.fires_on: The final piece of 'contraindicated' (the 'icated' ending) in interaction tables and contraindication text. Also the '-ly' or '-ally' ending of route words like intramuscularly and intraperitoneally.

modes.label: Contraindicated ending
modes.description: The last piece of 'Contraindicated' or 'contraindicated' after the word has been started.

modes.label: Route adverb ending
modes.description: The '-ly' or '-ally' ending of a route of administration word after a dose.
modes.example: Administer vitamin B 12 , 1 mg intramuscular<<ly>>, 1 week prior to the first

card.plain: It fires on the last part of the word contraindicated and of words like intramuscularly.
